column9: "Great appetite! Your cat ate well today."
"Ate slightly less than usual, but still normal."
"Eating less today. Monitor. If continues 2 days, see vet."
"Emergency: Cat refuses to eat! Contact vet immediately."
"Ate too much! Consider reducing to ___ grams."
"Food intake is perfect. Keep it up!"
"Eating too little. May be sick. See a vet."
"Emergency: Rapid breathing. Possible heart/lung issue. Contact vet now!"
"Bad breath. Possible kidney or dental disease."
"Missed medication. Take as soon as possible."
